title: Public playtest: password screen, Alpha notice, feedback
description: The new screens of the public playtest server: the shared-password screen, the Alpha notice with the build footer in the lobby, the floating Feedback button in a game and the lobby, the phone menu entry, and the feedback sheet (empty, filled, sent). Mocked fixtures (health answers public:true); desktop 1440x900 and phone 390x844. Regenerate with npm run screenshots -- CX.

shots.heading: Password screen, phone 390x844
shots.caption: Shown when the API answers 401 access_required. 16px field (no iOS zoom), 48px button, Alpha badge.

shots.heading: Wrong password
shots.caption: The error stays on the screen; after too many tries the message changes to a wait notice.

shots.heading: Lobby, phone
shots.caption: Alpha notice at the top of the lobby, build footer (commit and protocol) at the bottom, floating Feedback button in the corner.

shots.heading: In a game, phone
shots.caption: The Feedback button floats above the Players / Events buttons and the bottom action bar, inside the safe area.

shots.heading: In a game, desktop
shots.caption: Bottom right, above the turn action bar.

shots.heading: Phone top menu
shots.caption: Send feedback is also an entry in the phone menu.

shots.heading: Feedback sheet, empty (phone)
shots.caption: Category chips (Bug, Confusing, Idea, Other), free text up to 4000 characters, Include game info ticked by default; Send is disabled until there is text.

shots.heading: Feedback sheet, filled (phone)
shots.caption: Category Confusing and a typed report.

notes.title: What is sent
notes.text: Only the build commit, protocol versions, viewport, browser and timestamp, plus (box ticked) game id, the viewer's seat and faction, round and phase, the open decision (subtype, prompt, option ids) and the last 20 public events, all read from the viewer-projected snapshot. Never the raw state, seat tokens or other seats' events.

notes.title: Where
notes.text: web/src/access, web/src/feedback, web/src/components/AlphaNotice.tsx; server side crates/ti4-server/src/public and feedback.rs.
